description: Test whether the human PLPBP N-terminus resembles a cleavable mitochondrial targeting presequence, against matched mitochondrial and cytosolic reference sets
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats

def getseq(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(t.split("\n")[1:])

# known mitochondrial MATRIX proteins with cleavable presequences
mito = {"OAT":"P04181","GOT2":"P00505","ALDH7A1":"P49419","SHMT2":"P34897","GLDC":"P23378",
        "AGXT2":"Q9BYV1","ABAT":"P80404","OTC":"P00480","CS":"O75390","MDH2":"P40926",
        "SDHA":"P31040","ACAT1":"P24752","HSPD1":"P10809","PCCA":"P05165","IVD":"P26440"}
# known cytosolic proteins (no presequence)
cyto = {"GOT1":"P17174","SHMT1":"P34896","GAPDH":"P04406","PKM":"P14618","LDHA":"P00338",
        "TPI1":"P60174","ENO1":"P06733","ALDOA":"P04075","PGK1":"P00558","CAT_PSAT1":"Q9Y617",
        "PNPO":"Q9NVS9","PDXK":"O00764","CBS":"P35520","GOT1L1":"Q8NHS2","SRM":"P19623"}

pos=set("KR"); neg=set("DE"); hyd=set("AVLIFWMYC")
def feat(s, n=30):
    w=s[:n]
    return dict(npos=sum(c in pos for c in w), nneg=sum(c in neg for c in w),
                net=sum(c in pos for c in w)-sum(c in neg for c in w),
                fhyd=sum(c in hyd for c in w)/len(w),
                nS=sum(c in "ST" for c in w)/len(w),
                nR=sum(c=="R" for c in w))

rows=[]
for grp,dd in [("mitochondrial matrix",mito),("cytosolic",cyto)]:
    for g,a in dd.items():
        s=getseq(a); f=feat(s); f.update(gene=g,group=grp); rows.append(f)
hs=getseq("O94903"); f=feat(hs); f.update(gene="PLPBP",group="PLPBP"); rows.append(f)
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
print(df.groupby("group")[["npos","nneg","net","fhyd","nR"]].mean().round(2).to_string())
print("\nPLPBP N-terminal 30 residues:", hs[:30])
print(df[df.group=="PLPBP"][["npos","nneg","net","fhyd","nR"]].to_string(index=False))

m=df[df.group=="mitochondrial matrix"]["net"]; c=df[df.group=="cytosolic"]["net"]
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(m,c,alternative="greater")
print("\nNet charge (first 30 aa): mito median {:.1f}, cyto median {:.1f}, Mann-Whitney p={:.4f}".format(
    np.median(m), np.median(c), p))
plp_net=float(df[df.group=="PLPBP"]["net"].iloc[0])
print("PLPBP net charge = {:.0f}".format(plp_net))
print("z vs mito distribution: {:.2f};  z vs cyto distribution: {:.2f}".format(
    (plp_net-m.mean())/m.std(), (plp_net-c.mean())/c.std()))
print("percentile of PLPBP within mito set: {:.0f}".format(100*(m<plp_net).mean()))
print("percentile of PLPBP within cyto set: {:.0f}".format(100*(c<plp_net).mean()))

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(6.5,4.2))
for i,(g,col) in enumerate([("mitochondrial matrix","#4C78A8"),("cytosolic","#B0B0B0")]):
    v=df[df.group==g]["net"].values
    ax.scatter(np.random.normal(i,0.07,len(v)), v, color=col, s=45, label=g+" (n=15)")
    ax.hlines(np.median(v), i-0.2,i+0.2, color="black", lw=2)
ax.axhline(plp_net, color="#D62728", ls="--", lw=1.5)
ax.text(1.45, plp_net+0.2, "PLPBP (net {:.0f})".format(plp_net), color="#D62728", ha="right", fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks([0,1]); ax.set_xticklabels(["mitochondrial matrix","cytosolic"])
ax.set_ylabel("Net charge of N-terminal 30 residues (K+R minus D+E)")
ax.set_title("PLPBP lacks the strong positive N-terminal charge of\ncleavable mitochondrial presequences")
ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, loc="upper right")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
